# SurajWood — Complete Technical & Product Reference (LLMs Full)

## Company Overview
Suraj Wood Products Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian architectural surfaces manufacturer established in 2011 with a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Bahadurgarh, Jhajjar, Haryana.

## Core Manufacturing Technology
1. **PMMA Acrylic Surface**: Extruded optical-grade Polymethyl Methacrylate (PMMA) acrylic layer (1.0mm - 1.5mm thickness). PMMA possesses high chemical inertness, UV resistance, and optical clarity.
2. **PUR Flat-Lamination**: Utilizes reactive Polyurethane (PUR) hotmelt adhesives. Unlike standard EVA or water-based PVA adhesives, PUR undergoes a secondary moisture-cure cross-linking reaction that produces an insoluble, heat-stable (up to 120°C), and waterproof bond.
3. **Calibrated Substrates**: Core materials include E1-grade low-emission Medium Density Fibreboard (MDF), calibrated multi-ply hardwood plywood, and high-density particle board (PB).
4. **Balancing Backer**: Each panel features a color-matched or white balancing backer sheet of identical thermal expansion properties to prevent warping over 10+ year operational lifetimes.

## Products
- **ACRYLUX**: High-Gloss Prelaminated Acrylic Panels (37+ shades)
- **ACRYSILK**: Soft Satin Anti-Fingerprint Acrylic Panels (10+ shades)
- **ACRYMATTE**: Super Matte Nano-Coated Acrylic Panels (15+ shades)
- **ACRYGLASS**: 95% Mirror Reflectivity Glass Acrylic Panels (8+ shades)
- **ACRYGLASS MATTE**: Frosted Matte-Glass Acrylic Panels (8+ shades)
- **3D Membrane Shutters**: 3D Membrane wrapped modular kitchen & wardrobe shutters
- **AL-PROFHAN Hardware**: Precision extruded aluminum profile handles and glass frame profiles

## Pan-India Reach
SurajWood provides direct supply and dealer coverage across 50 major cities throughout North India, West India, South India, and East India.
